content.summary: A stage technician performs a cable-inspired solo routine on a fixed rehearsal floor. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity is established in full body. + The stage and floor registration remain fixed. + Actions connect through plausible body transitions. + The largest movement occurs only once. + The same subject returns to a readable held stance.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult stage technician with a teal headset and orange utility jacket on a fixed pale rehearsal floor. Continue into two connected footwork poses while face, headset, jacket and floor marks remain fixed. Return the same technician to a front-facing balanced stance and hold for one clean final beat.
